title: Iman Gadzhi's 7 productivity hacks: protect attention, plan the night before, cut daily decisions
summary: Iman Gadzhi argues productivity comes from guarding attention and removing decisions, not from elaborate routines. He covers treating YouTube and books as entertainment, planning tomorrow tonight, uniform clothes and meals, deleting TikTok, muting Instagram, and a short three-step morning routine.

principles.text: Learning only counts when it is intentional and tied to a problem you know you must solve; passive consumption is entertainment.
principles.quote: the only thing that I would consider proper learning is when you know exactly what you need to do and you're educating yourself on how to do it

principles.text: Strip algorithmic feeds (home feed, sidebar, comments) and keep only subscriptions to protect attention and focus.
principles.quote: you need to be extremely diligent with where you put your attention

principles.text: Plan tomorrow the night before with just three to five tasks so you start the day with intention.
principles.quote: just very simply write three to five things down tonight before tomorrow starts and you'll see your brain starts working overnight and you go into tomorrow with real intention

principles.text: Remove repeat decisions: wear a simple uniform, meal prep the same food for the week, lay out clothes the night before.
principles.quote: the worst thing in the morning that you can have is the decision fatigue of deciding okay what am I going to wear today

principles.text: Treat food as fuel so it doesn't consume your life; save enjoyment for holidays and restaurants.
principles.quote: make sure food does not take up a crazy amount of your life meal prep at the beginning of the week and just make sure it's the same food for the entire week

principles.text: Keep the morning routine to three steps and under about 90 minutes; long routines are fluff.
principles.quote: just make sure it's a three-step morning routine no 10-step or 12 step and nothing that takes four hours
